setup: Exactly as p27-cd68-smoke-01 / p27-cd69-smoke-03 (new /tmp data dir and tiny git project, `python -m workbench start --data-dir <tmp> --no-attach` from the project dir, ui_v1 client; attach the real product UI in a PTY at least once for status-line text screenshots). Record `omp --version` and the start isolation-check result for both roles (ok/leaks/warnings) — this is the OMP 18.7.0 isolation evidence.
scenario: S3 manager recovery: type into the manager pane: '터미널에서 `sleep 30; echo cd70-s3-done` 를 실행하고 결과를 알려줘'. When the worker's command is running, exit the manager OMP (e.g. /exit or Ctrl-D twice in the manager pane via the UI client) so the worker's done report cannot be delivered; wait until the worker reports done (deferred); then restart the exited manager pane through the existing UI restart (C-D62). Record: manager_recovery notice, the re-sent report delivered to the new manager session, workbench_status call if any, and what the manager tells the user.

S1 watchdog: type into the manager pane: '터미널에서 `sleep 20; echo cd70-s1-done` 를 실행하고 결과를 알려줘'. As soon as the worker's terminal command is running, the worker turn ends (by design, 120 s wait not reached — fine). Once the command has finished and the worker has gone idle WITHOUT reporting is unlikely; to force the stalled path deterministically: right after the worker receives the TASK, press Escape in the worker pane via the UI client to abort its turn before it calls terminal (retry once if missed). Then wait: record whether Workbench sends status_check after ~60 s idle, what the worker does (expected: runs the listed command / reports), and if it stays idle, the 2nd check and the manager's worker_stalled notice and the manager's reaction. Record timings.
After each scenario: host shell usable (follow-up command works). Note any host pane line overprint after follow-up commands (user's open observation).
limits: Hard cap 30 provider requests total across both roles, wall clock 20 min. The request counter must be fail-closed: count from the temp OMP home session jsonl files of BOTH roles, re-resolving files across OMP restarts (new session ids, None during restart); if the counter thread errors or cannot read for >2 s, pause Workbench automation immediately and do not type further input until it recovers. Pause at 28 to leave margin for in-flight turns. Order: S3 first, then S1. If the cap would cut a scenario, stop, shut down (verified) and report.
smoke-01 lesson: do not instruct the manager to re-run commands; S1/S3 prompts as written. For S1, if Escape misses the window, do not retry more than once.

Never touch ~/wb-urux-sandbox or the user's running Workbench/OMP processes; kill only PIDs you started; never read credential contents or other processes' environ (agent.db symlink: metadata only); never print tokens; no commits; no graphify update; remove temp dirs afterwards (keep short logs/timeline under the run dir without secrets).
